journal.attuned.title: Attunement Journal
journal.attuned.line1: Foci work only while equipped and inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.line2: Slot order is priority: higher slots wake first when capacity is tight.
journal.attuned.line3: Fury beats Bastion, Bastion beats Zephyr, and Zephyr beats Fury.
journal.attuned.line4: Mixing active affinities creates Discord: more damage dealt and taken.
journal.attuned.line5: Three matching Foci can awaken a Pact. Four committed Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.
journal.attuned.line6: Bind shards at an Attunement Altar, and craft four fragments into one shard.
journal.attuned.line7: The Unseen reward stillness, shadows, and openings rather than raw force.
journal.attuned.line8: Foci and shard fragments are found through vanilla loot, including Lootr-style chests.
journal.attuned.page1:
Attunement Journal

Equip Foci in the side slots of your inventory.

A Focus only works while it is awake inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.page2:
Priority

Higher Focus slots wake first.

If your total cost is too high, lower slots go dormant before higher slots.
journal.attuned.page3:
Capacity

Capacity is your build budget.

Bind Attunement Shards at an Altar to raise it, up to the server's cap.
journal.attuned.page4:
Affinities

Fury beats Bastion.
Bastion beats Zephyr.
Zephyr beats Fury.

Neutral Foci fit any build.
journal.attuned.page5:
Discord

Using two or more active affinities creates Discord.

You deal more damage, but you also take more damage.
journal.attuned.page6:
Pacts

Three active Foci of one affinity can awaken a Pact.

Pacts reward committing to a lane instead of wearing every trick at once.
journal.attuned.page7:
Apex

Four committed Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.

Build combat resonance to wake the capstone moment.
journal.attuned.page8:
Shards and Altars

Four Shard Fragments craft into one Attunement Shard.

Place a shard in the Altar and press Bind.
journal.attuned.page9:
The Unseen

These Foci favor quiet movement, smoke, veils, and ambush openings.

They are a faction, not a fourth affinity.
journal.attuned.page10:
Finding Foci

Attuned adds Foci and shard fragments to vanilla loot: structures, fishing treasure, archaeology, and trial rewards.

Lootr chests use the same chest tables.
journal.attuned.page11:
First Builds

At capacity 4, keep it plain.

Swift and Leap make a travel kit. Harvest and Nightgaze make a calm work kit. Vital can stand alone.
journal.attuned.page12:
Capacity 6

Try Iron and Emberward for a Bastion guard.

Edge and Frenzy favor Fury raids.

Swift, Leap, and Softstep suit Zephyr roads.
journal.attuned.page13:
Adjusting

If a Focus sleeps, move it to a higher slot or lower the cost.

Bind shards for more capacity. Neutral Foci are easiest to fit.
